requirement: For a Cargo workspace that depends on `habeas`, enabling its Symposium plugin with `cargo agents use habeas` MUST make the agent skills shipped with the selected Habeas version available to the user's configured agents. After the selected version changes, `cargo agents sync` MUST provide the skills shipped with the new version.
rationale: Initial enablement installed all three skills in a temporary consumer workspace with a local Habeas dependency. Version refresh did not pass the local Symposium 0.5.1 check: in a two-version local dependency test, cargo update selected v0.2.0 but cargo agents sync retained the v0.1.0 skill. This needs investigation or a Symposium fix.
